papers_found.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_found.author: Yimin Du
papers_found.notes: Chinese A-shares, 500-1000 stocks, gradient boosting + bias correction + cross-sectional neutralization. Annualized 20%, Sharpe >2.0. Key technique: tensor-accelerated factor computation and GBM data augmentation. Validates design choices for H202-XL on large US universe.

papers_found.title: A Practical Machine Learning Approach for Dynamic Stock Recommendation
papers_found.author: Yang, Liu, Wu
papers_found.notes: S&P 500 top-20% selection using gradient boosted regression among 5 ML methods. Outperforms buy-and-hold on Sharpe. Confirms gradient boosting competitive on large US universe.

papers_found.title: Generative AI for Stock Selection
papers_found.author: Keywan Christian Rasekhschaffe
papers_found.notes: GenAI + gradient-boosted tabular model on US equities. Sharpe 1.14-1.63 in ensemble configs. Critical finding: cross-sectional rank standardization is essential — equity prediction is about relative stock positioning, not absolute values. Key design input for H202-XL feature engineering.

papers_found.title: A New Puzzle Piece for the 'Sell in May, and Go Away' Anomaly: Regulatory Disclosures
papers_found.author: Jan L. Schroeder (TU Dortmund)
papers_found.venue: International Journal of Financial Studies, Vol. 13, Issue 4 (MDPI)
papers_found.notes: SEC filings 17% higher in winter (Nov-Apr) vs summer (May-Oct), 2004-2023. February highest, September lowest. 22% more insider trading, 473% more annual reports in winter. Structural information-flow mechanism for Halloween effect. Strengthens H206 hypothesis significantly.

papers_found.title: Time-varying performance of betting against beta (BAB) and other risk-based anomalies: Evidence from Asia
papers_found.author: ScienceDirect (Multiple authors)
papers_found.venue: ScienceDirect (journal TBD — Borsa Istanbul Review or similar)
papers_found.notes: BAB works only during market downturns in 5 Asian markets (1999-2021). Disposition effect drives regime-conditional performance. Risk flag for H205: add SPY-200MA regime-split diagnostic to backtest.

papers_reviewed_not_staged.title: Application of Deep Learning for Factor Timing in Asset Management
papers_reviewed_not_staged.notes: Deep learning for factor timing on Fama-French factors 1963-2022. Not directly actionable — H205 is a rule-based calendar overlay, not a learned timing model. Queue if H205 fails and we want to try learned BAB timing.

papers_reviewed_not_staged.title: Optimal Factor Timing in a High-Dimensional Setting
papers_reviewed_not_staged.notes: Northern Trust / U Chicago paper on factor timing, March 2025. Relevant to longer-term factor rotation but not directly to TOM overlay design.
